description:
Search for invoices or recurring invoice series on PayPal.

Use resource_type "invoice" with invoice_filters, or "recurring_series" with recurring_series_filters -- only set the matching filters object. Recurring series search covers only the past 3 years.

inputSchema.description: Search for invoices or recurring invoice series, depending on resource_type.

invoice_filters.description: Filters to apply when resource_type is 'invoice'. Must not be set when resource_type is 'recurring_series'.

creation_date_range.description: Filters invoices by the date and time PayPal's system recorded the invoice record as created (an internal system timestamp, NOT the invoice's own date). For 'invoices dated/created between X and Y' requests, prefer invoice_date_range unless the user specifically means when the record was created in PayPal.

end.description: The end date and time, in ISO8601 format (for example, 2018-06-21T23:59:59Z). Seconds are required; fractional seconds are optional. A plain date (yyyy-MM-DD) is also accepted and is expanded to the end of that day (23:59:59Z).

start.description: The start date and time, in ISO8601 format (for example, 2018-06-01T00:00:00Z). Seconds are required; fractional seconds are optional. A plain date (yyyy-MM-DD) is also accepted and is expanded to the start of that day (00:00:00Z).

currency_code.description: Filters invoices by the three-character ISO-4217 currency code.

due_date_range.description: Filters invoices whose due date falls within this range.

end.description: The end date, in yyyy-MM-DD format.

start.description: The start date, in yyyy-MM-DD format.

invoice_date_range.description: Filters invoices by the invoice's own date (the date shown on the invoice itself, also called the billing date). Use this for most 'invoices dated/created/issued between X and Y' requests -- creation_date_range is for PayPal's internal record-creation timestamp, not the invoice's date.

end.description: The end date, in yyyy-MM-DD format.

start.description: The start date, in yyyy-MM-DD format.

payment_date_range.description: Filters invoices by the date and time PayPal recorded the invoice as paid (a system timestamp).

end.description: The end date and time, in ISO8601 format (for example, 2018-06-21T23:59:59Z). Seconds are required; fractional seconds are optional. A plain date (yyyy-MM-DD) is also accepted and is expanded to the end of that day (23:59:59Z).

start.description: The start date and time, in ISO8601 format (for example, 2018-06-01T00:00:00Z). Seconds are required; fractional seconds are optional. A plain date (yyyy-MM-DD) is also accepted and is expanded to the start of that day (00:00:00Z).

recipient_business_name.description: Filters invoices by the recipient's business name.

recipient_email.description: Filters invoices by the recipient's email address.

recipient_first_name.description: Filters invoices by the recipient's first name.

recipient_last_name.description: Filters invoices by the recipient's last name.

reference.description: Filters invoices by reference value, such as a purchase order number.

status.description: Filters invoices by one or more statuses (up to 5).

total_amount_range.description: Filters invoices whose total amount falls within this range.

lower_amount.description: The lower bound of the amount range.

currency_code.description: The three-character ISO-4217 currency code that identifies the currency.

value.description: The amount, as a signed decimal string with up to 2 decimal places (e.g. '50.00').

upper_amount.description: The upper bound of the amount range.

currency_code.description: The three-character ISO-4217 currency code that identifies the currency.

value.description: The amount, as a signed decimal string with up to 2 decimal places (e.g. '50.00').

page.description: The page number of the result set to fetch.

page_size.description: The number of records to return per page (maximum 100).

recurring_series_filters.description: Filters to apply when resource_type is 'recurring_series'. Must not be set when resource_type is 'invoice'.

search_fields.description: The fields that search_text searches against (1-5 values, must be unique).

search_filters.description: Structured filters for the recurring series search.

creation_date_range.description: Filters recurring series by the date and time PayPal recorded the series as created (a system timestamp). This endpoint has no separate 'series date' field -- for 'series created/started between X and Y' requests, this is the field to use. Mutually exclusive with next_occurrence_date_range -- PayPal supports only one range criterion per search.

end.description: The end date and time, in ISO8601 format (for example, 2018-06-21T23:59:59Z). Seconds are required; fractional seconds are optional. A plain date (yyyy-MM-DD) is also accepted and is expanded to the end of that day (23:59:59Z).

start.description: The start date and time, in ISO8601 format (for example, 2018-06-01T00:00:00Z). Seconds are required; fractional seconds are optional. A plain date (yyyy-MM-DD) is also accepted and is expanded to the start of that day (00:00:00Z).

currency_code.description: Filters recurring series by the three-character ISO-4217 currency code.

next_occurrence_date_range.description: Filters recurring series whose next occurrence date falls within this range. Mutually exclusive with creation_date_range -- PayPal supports only one range criterion per search.

end.description: The end date, in yyyy-MM-DD format.

start.description: The start date, in yyyy-MM-DD format.

status.description: Filters recurring series by one or more statuses (up to 5, must be unique).

total_amount_range.description: Filters recurring series whose total amount falls within this range.

lower_amount.description: The lower bound of the amount range.

currency_code.description: The three-character ISO-4217 currency code that identifies the currency.

value.description: The amount, as a signed decimal string with up to 2 decimal places (e.g. '50.00').

upper_amount.description: The upper bound of the amount range.

currency_code.description: The three-character ISO-4217 currency code that identifies the currency.

value.description: The amount, as a signed decimal string with up to 2 decimal places (e.g. '50.00').

search_text.description: Free-text search across the fields listed in search_fields. Cannot be blank.

resource_type.description: Which resource type to search. 'invoice' searches individual invoices using invoice_filters; 'recurring_series' searches recurring invoice series using recurring_series_filters.

total_required.description: Indicates whether the response should include the total count of matching invoices. Only applies when resource_type is 'invoice'.

name: search_invoicing
